chunks: And We shall single out one witness from each community and say: 'Bring your proof.' Then will they know that God's is the judgement, and what they contrived will avail them not in the least.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the witnesses from each community on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'witness' (shahid) extracted from each community is often interpreted as the Prophet or Imam of that nation, whose testimony exposes the internal contradictions of the disbelievers. This scene underscores the futility of human reasoning when detached from divine revelation, as the fabricated idols and false proofs of the polytheists are revealed to be empty. The verse highlights the ultimate realization of truth (al-Haqq) belonging exclusively to Allah, a core tenet in Shia theological discussions on Tawhid and the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as witnesses over creation.
